notes: v216 — SECURITY: DATA BEHIND SIGN-IN (owner's videos, Oct 21, 2026 15:26 + 15:28 MDT). After an uninstall/reinstall the app restored his whole day but stood signed OUT in local mode, rendering everything in the clear — revenue, the invoice total, the last fuel fill, the active dispatch, PTI status, the connection count, his account type in the drawer: 'I am not even signed in and all my information is out there... Leave it outside the door?' And the second account's Preferences showed HIS profile instead of the Dave Cooper / Owner-Operator profile he had left on it: identity bled across accounts on one device. (1) THE LOCK: signed out, NOTHING of the user's data renders — App.onAuth runs the profile gate first, then (signed out) blanks every painted surface (dashboard grid, drawer menu + account block, module surface, onboarding surface, park card, trial bar) and holds the sign-in screen as the only screen; App.showView('main'), App.showDashboard and App.openModule refuse while locked, the dashboard/sidebar builders paint nothing while locked, tracker paints show only a neutral hero, and LiveMiles / the park card check the same lock — no entry point (deep link, restored tab, sync repaint, back button) bypasses the door. Data stays stored untouched; the moment he signs in, everything restores bit-for-bit — the survival he praised is preserved — and signing out mid-session clears the rendered surface at once while the session runs on underneath. (2) PROFILE OWNERSHIP: the profile record ('onboarding') is owned by the signed-in account — CloudSync.profileGate swaps the local slot at every auth change (outgoing record stashed per-uid in mt___profiles, incoming owner's record activated, or the slot vacated so the sign-in pull takes THAT account's cloud profile wholesale; a gate-vacated slot's pull merge is cloud-wins so shell defaults stamped pre-pull can never beat the account's own answers). One account's profile can never render under another — not after account switches, not after an uninstall/reinstall + backup restore lands stale data before sign-in. Proven by the new suite signin-lock-v216 (92 assertions: the REAL app boots in a vm over a seeded signed-out day mirroring his video; the walked DOM holds none of the seeded figures/labels and every bypass lands on the sign-in screen; sign-in restores the same figures; sign-out blanks synchronously with the session still running; Account B's sign-in renders only B's profile — Preferences included — with A's record intact in its own slot, and the round trip back to A restores A). Full suite: green except three failures that pre-date this change on pristine v215 HEAD (boss-firstrun, connect-pipe, role-package's stale office-set pin vs the v213 PTI role split). Ships as webVersion 216.
